# Icosahedron Stellation

## Overview

Add a stellation of the icosahedron -- any of the 59 (Coxeter/
Du Val/Flather/Petrie, "The Fifty-Nine Icosahedra"), by Crennell
index, or a custom set of Du Val cell shells.
